build_preprocess_pipeline: build a torchvision preprocessing pipeline with resize, center crop, and ImageNet normalization
create_preprocess_from_crop_res: create a preprocessing transform given a crop resolution and optional resize resolution
create_preprocess_from_model_info: create a preprocessing transform from a model info dictionary containing resolution and resize keys
test_get_preprocess: test the get_preprocess function with various crop and resize resolution combinations
review_preprocess_normalization: review the ImageNet normalization mean and std values used in the preprocessing pipeline
